# `region_pca`

each region's signal as the first principal component of its sources over a span (a linear map of the channels), signed as the reference signs it.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run region_pca --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run region_pca --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run noisecov --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --from 5 --to 150 --name rest_A_cov
nxr-neuro run region_pca --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --from 5 --to 150 --kernel headmodel_lcmv --covariance rest_A_cov --partition desikan_killiany --name fp_A_regions
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel"} | yes |
| `covariance` | statistic any, where {"measure": "covariance", "name": "$covariance"} | yes |
| `sources` | manifold surface, is kernel.to | yes |
| `partition` | selection set, manifold sources.manifold.0, where {"name": "$partition"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `required` | - |  | the fixed-orientation inverse kernel the sources are read through (`nxr-neuro run lcmv`) |
| `covariance` | `--covariance` | `required` | - |  | the channels' covariance over the SAME span as this run, one block with its mean removed (`nxr-neuro run noisecov` over that span) |
| `partition` | `--partition` | `required` | - |  | the regions: a partition of the kernel's source surface (an atlas, e.g. Desikan-Killiany's 68 regions) |
| `name` | `--name` | `{kernel}_{partition}_pca` | - |  | the region map's name; beside it <name>_channels |
| `sign_flip` | `--sign-flip` | true | - |  | flip each source's sign by its orientation before the component, as the reference's scouts do |
| `normals` | `--normals` | `brainstorm` | - | brainstorm, corner_angle | the sources' orientations: brainstorm (the reference's VertNormals: minus the sum of the incident faces' unit normals, normalised) \| corner_angle (geometry-central's corner-angle weighted normals) |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`meeg.region_pca_basis`](../nodes.md) | kernel=kernel, covariance=covariance, partition=partition, sources=sources | sign_flip=$sign_flip, normals=$normals | basis |
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.region_pca`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, basis=basis |  | map, channels |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `channels` | kind selection, type indices, name $name_channels, on recording.manifold.0 |
| `map` | kind operator, operator_kind region map, name $name, from recording.manifold.0, to kernel.to, from_selection channels, to_selection partition, derived_from kernel |

## Notes from the definition

```text
EACH REGION'S SIGNAL AS THE FIRST PRINCIPAL COMPONENT OF ITS SOURCES over a span (Brainstorm's scout function PCA with the sign flip, applied before the spectrum, as the MEG fingerprinting
paper does: da Silva Castanheira J, Orozco Perez HD, Misic B, Baillet S (2021) Nat Commun 12:5713, doi:10.1038/s41467-021-25895-8; megFingerprinting v1.0.0, 06fdba8; written from the
documented behaviour of bst_scout_value of Brainstorm's release of 2018-10-12). Every stored result carries these references (producer_json.references).

THE GRAPH (a span-wide component is a statistic made first, then applied pointwise):
  the channels' covariance over the span: a statistic made first by `run noisecov` over THE SAME span, one block, its mean removed (no block_seconds)
  before:  meeg.region_pca_basis   kernel (fixed orientation) + covariance + partition + the sources' normals  ->  per region the leading eigenvector of D K_R C K_R^T D (D the sign flip
                                   by orientation) as channel weights, and the flipped kernel row of the source it loads most (the peak)
  chunks:  meeg.region_pca         the recording over the span, through those 2R weights (pointwise, a linear map), measured over the span (max, min, mean: one member of a time rule)
                                   ->  each component's sign from the extremes, as the reference's; the region map (regions x channels) and each region's offset
Stored: the region map `<name>` (an operator from the recording's channels to the partition's regions: a region's signal is map x + its offset) and its channels `<name>_channels`; per region in
the map's provenance (producer.regions): its sources, those flipped, the peak source, the share explained, the sign and the offset (the peak source's mean, less the signed component's).
A spectrum of the regions reads the map as it reads a kernel (`--kernel <name>`); the offsets matter only to the signal's mean.
It cannot resolve: the component is the direction of most variance within a region over THIS span (it changes between spans and between people); it carries its share (`explained`, per
region in the provenance) of the region's signal and leaves out the rest; its sign is a convention set by the span's extremes; the regions share signal through the kernel's spread.

  nxr-neuro run noisecov --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --from 5 --to 150 --name rest_A_cov
  nxr-neuro run region_pca --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --from 5 --to 150 --kernel headmodel_lcmv --covariance rest_A_cov --partition desikan_killiany --name fp_A_regions
```
